title: Lecture 13 — Bases, dimension, and rank
summary: Find independent spanning sets and connect pivots, image dimension and nullity.
body: Curriculum-backed study companion to the official Lecture 13 plan and Module 5 guide, sections 7.1–7.6. This is not a transcript or evidence of classroom delivery. Work through basis selection, original pivot columns, row-space and null-space bases, and rank-nullity. Projection, least squares and Gram–Schmidt preparation is linked in the Module 5 practice pack; their later lecture notes are not yet available.
